title.narrative: Multisectoral humanitarian assistance to conflict-affected populations in Southern Lebanon

description.narrative: Objective: Provision of life-saving cash for food and basic needs and protection interventions for crisis-affected populations.

This intervention will support vulnerable individuals and households who remain in unsafe and hard-to-reach areas within a 10 km radius of the Lebanon-Israel border also known as the Blue Line (Districts of Bent Jbeil, Marjaayoun and Hasbaya) as well as addressing IDPs who have moved to safer areas in Tyre district and Nabatieh Governorate. Outcome: Provision of life-saving cash for food and basic needs and protection interventions for crisis-affected populations. Activities include: provision of cash (for food and non-food items) and case management, cash for protection and MHPSS).All cash assistance will be provided as unconditional Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to support vulnerable families in covering their most urgent food, non-food and protection needs.

Total Participants : 15150. Severely socio-economically vulnerable displaced households, host households and households remaining in the conflict zone in South Lebanon, will be eligible for the multipurpose cash assistance component of the proposed intervention to cover their food and basic assistance needs, aiming to enable them to meet basic needs without increasing negative coping mechanisms
